frontend/components/Nav.tsx::Nav.detail: Client component rendering a fixed 56-width sidebar of links. Highlights the link matching current path; no inputs, no side effects.

frontend/app/login/page.tsx::LoginPage.oneLiner: Login form page, auths then routes to inbox
frontend/app/login/page.tsx::LoginPage.detail: Client component rendering email/password form; on submit calls api.login and pushes /inbox on success. Holds local state for fields, error, and busy; shows error text and disables button while request runs.

frontend/app/layout.tsx::RootLayout.oneLiner: Next.js root layout wrapping all pages
frontend/app/layout.tsx::RootLayout.detail: Renders the html/body shell for every route; receives page content as children. Wraps children in Shell (nav/chrome) and sets lang="en".

frontend/components/InfoBanner.tsx::Info.oneLiner: Dismissible help banner persisted via localStorage
frontend/components/InfoBanner.tsx::Info.detail: Client component showing 3-step "How it works" explainer; reads localStorage key "flow_help_dismissed" on mount to decide visibility, returns null when dismissed. Hide button sets that key to "1" and hides; starts hidden until effect runs, so SSR/first paint renders nothing (no flash).

backend/app/main.py::lifespan.oneLiner: FastAPI lifespan handler; runs init_db on startup
backend/app/main.py::lifespan.detail: Async context manager passed to FastAPI(lifespan=...). Calls init_db() before yield (startup), yields nothing after (no shutdown logic).

backend/app/main.py::health.detail: Returns {"status": "ok"}. No inputs, no side effects; used for liveness/readiness probes.

backend/alembic/env.py::run_migrations_o.oneLiner: Emit migration SQL without DB connection
backend/alembic/env.py::run_migrations_o.detail: Configures Alembic context with a raw DB URL and literal_binds so SQL is rendered as a script instead of executed via a live connection. Uses named paramstyle, compares column types, and runs migrations inside one transaction.

backend/alembic/env.py::run_migrations_o.oneLiner: Run migrations against a live DB connection
backend/alembic/env.py::run_migrations_o.detail: Builds an Engine from the alembic.ini sqlalchemy.* config with a NullPool (no connection reuse), opens a connection, and runs migrations in a transaction with type comparison enabled. Applies schema changes directly to the target database.

backend/app/agents/bill_handler.py::_moc.oneLiner: Stub LLM response for bill categorization
backend/app/agents/bill_handler.py::_moc.detail: Ignores user arg, returns fixed dict with account_code 5000, name 'Software Subscriptions', confidence 0.88. Passed as fallback to complete_json when no real LLM.

backend/app/agents/bill_handler.py::run.oneLiner: Build proposed AP journal entry from bill data
backend/app/agents/bill_handler.py::run.detail: Takes db Session and bill dict (entity_id, vendor, amount, bill_id, lines). Dedups on bill_id via pending_exists, calls complete_json to pick GL account (falls back to 5000), builds debit-GL/credit-AP(2000) lines, returns ProposedAction via propose (action_type 'stage_payable') or None if duplicate.

backend/app/routers/webhooks.py::BankLin.oneLiner: Pydantic body schema for bank webhook
backend/app/routers/webhooks.py::BankLin.detail: Fields: entity_id int, amount float, description str, optional date str. Validates incoming bank line payload; date is ISO string or null.

backend/app/routers/webhooks.py::Invoice.oneLiner: Pydantic body schema for invoice webhook
backend/app/routers/webhooks.py::Invoice.detail: Fields: entity_id int, vendor str, amount float, optional due_date str, lines dict default empty. Validates incoming invoice payload.

backend/app/routers/webhooks.py::bank_we.oneLiner: Persist bank txn, publish BANK_LINE event
backend/app/routers/webhooks.py::bank_we.detail: Takes BankLineIn, DB session, controller-auth user. Writes BankTransaction (amount via Decimal(str), date defaults today), commits, publishes Event on bus, returns bank_transaction_id and event_id. Float->Decimal via str avoids binary rounding; commit before event so id exists.

backend/app/routers/webhooks.py::invoice.detail: Takes InvoiceIn, DB session, controller-auth user. Writes Bill (amount via Decimal(str), due_date defaults today, lines dict), commits, publishes Event, returns bill_id and event_id. Event data re-floats amount for JSON; commit precedes publish so bill.id set.

backend/app/agents/graph.py::GState.oneLiner: TypedDict holding graph state across nodes
backend/app/agents/graph.py::GState.detail: Keys: event_type, data, route, action_ids, source_event_id. total=False means all keys optional; nodes mutate and pass it along.

backend/app/agents/graph.py::_classify.detail: Reads event_type, looks up ROUTING default, asks LLM (complete_json) for a route, validates it against ROUTING values else falls back to default. Writes route into state and records an Orchestrator trace; mock returns default.

backend/app/agents/graph.py::_make_speci.oneLiner: Wraps agent run fn into a graph node
backend/app/agents/graph.py::_make_speci.detail: Returns a node that pulls db from _db_ctx, calls fn(db, data+source_event_id), and appends returned ProposedAction id(s) to state['action_ids']. Handles list or single action return; ignores falsy actions.

backend/app/agents/graph.py::_build.oneLiner: Builds and compiles the LangGraph state graph
backend/app/agents/graph.py::_build.detail: Adds classify node plus five specialist nodes (categorizer, bill_handler, ar_clerk, consolidator, closer). Edges: START→classify, conditional edge routes on state['route'], each specialist→END. Returns compiled graph.

backend/app/agents/graph.py::run_event.oneLiner: Entry point: run graph for one event, return action ids
backend/app/agents/graph.py::run_event.detail: Lazily builds/caches global _graph, sets db into _db_ctx contextvar, invokes graph with event_type/data/source_event_id, returns result['action_ids']. Resets contextvar in finally; not thread-safe on _graph init.

backend/alembic/versions/0001_initial.py.detail: Grabs Alembic connection via op.get_bind(), calls Base.metadata.create_all to emit CREATE TABLE for every model registered on Base. Bypasses incremental DDL—whole schema from metadata, so migration drifts if models change without new revision.

Grabs connection via op.get_bind(), calls Base.metadata.drop_all to DROP every table in Base.metadata. Destroys all data; drop order respects FK dependencies but anything not in metadata is left behind.

backend/app/agents/reconciler.py::_candi.oneLiner: Find posted entries matching bank txn amount
backend/app/agents/reconciler.py::_candi.detail: Returns all posted JournalEntries on same entity with a code-1000 cash line whose max(debit,credit) equals |bt.amount|, skipping entries already claimed by another bank line. Returns full list so caller detects ambiguity; iterates entry.lines in Python so cost grows with entry count.

backend/app/agents/reconciler.py::_date_.detail: Returns a lambda taking a JournalEntry, yielding absolute day distance from bt.date. Missing either date yields 10**9 sentinel so undated entries sort last.

backend/app/agents/reconciler.py::run.oneLiner: Propose reconciliation actions for unmatched bank txns
backend/app/agents/reconciler.py::run.detail: Loads entity's unmatched BankTransactions and emits ProposedActions: match_bank on exactly one candidate (confidence 0.93 same-day else 0.75), a note on multiple candidates (0.5, suggests date-closest), or a variance note on zero (0.6). Skips txns with an existing pending match_bank/note; each branch calls propose() which writes to db.

backend/app/routers/entities.py::list_en.oneLiner: Returns all entities as dict list ordered by id
backend/app/routers/entities.py::list_en.detail: GET-style handler. Injects DB session via Depends(get_db), runs SELECT on Entity ordered by id, maps each to dict with id, name, parent_id, currency. No pagination — returns entire table.

frontend/components/Nav.tsx.overview: Renders sidebar nav links; highlights active route via `usePathname`.

frontend/app/login/page.tsx.overview: Client login page. Owns email/password form state, calls `api` to authenticate, routes to inbox on success.

frontend/app/layout.tsx.overview: Next.js root layout. Wraps every page in `Shell` chrome and sets global metadata; imports `globals.css`.

frontend/components/InfoBanner.tsx.overview: Renders dismissible help banner. Tracks dismissed state via localStorage so banner stays hidden across sessions.

backend/app/main.py.overview: FastAPI app entrypoint. Builds app, sets CORS, mounts all routers, runs `init_db` on startup, exposes health check.

backend/alembic/env.py.overview: Alembic migration entrypoint. Wires app settings and `Base.metadata` into Alembic context, runs migrations offline (SQL emit) or online (live DB connection).

backend/app/agents/bill_handler.py.overview: Owns AP bill intake: turns bill data into proposed accounts-payable journal entry via LLM categorization, writing a `ProposedAction`. Guards against duplicates with `pending_exists`, resolves accounts through `account_id`, submits via shared `propose` helper.

backend/app/routers/webhooks.py.overview: Owns HTTP webhook ingestion. Two endpoints persist inbound bank transactions and vendor bills, then publish `BANK_LINE`/`INVOICE_RECEIVED` events to bus for downstream processing.

backend/app/agents/graph.py.overview: Owns the LangGraph orchestration: defines graph state, classifier routing node, and specialist node wrappers. Compiles the event-processing graph and exposes `run_event` as entry point dispatching one event to the right agent (ar_clerk, bill_handler, categorizer, closer, consolidator).

backend/alembic/versions/0001_initial.py.overview: Initial Alembic migration. Creates and drops all ORM tables from `Base.metadata`, defining the DB schema baseline for the app.

backend/app/agents/reconciler.py.overview: Reconciler agent: matches unmatched `BankTransaction` rows to posted `JournalEntry` records by amount and date proximity, then proposes reconciliation `ProposedAction`s. Read-only analysis that emits proposals via `propose`, guarded by `pending_exists` to avoid duplicates.

backend/app/routers/entities.py.overview: Owns entity read API. Exposes `list_entities` GET route returning all `Entity` rows via SQLAlchemy `select`, mounted on shared `APIRouter`.
